summary: Candel Therapeutics filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement covering up to $50,000,000 of common stock under a refreshed at-the-market program with Jefferies as sales agent. The company amended and restated its prior open market sale agreement on November 12, 2026, after fully exhausting the earlier $50 million facility; the prior prospectus is terminated. Sales occur at prevailing market prices under Rule 415(a)(4), with Jefferies paid a 3.0% fixed commission and no escrow. CADL closed at $9.22 on November 11, 2026. This is a routine shelf takedown, not a special situation; watch dilution pace and ATM utilization.
